recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source change is needed for FHIR-26558 unless a future issue asks to change the choice of example search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-26558 was Published with resolution Persuasive. It asked to clean up search.html#versions examples that used Observation?definition:below=http:http://acme.com/some-profile and the |1 variant.
initial_application: The bad examples originated in 9fedb176f1b13c7f956feb90cb4ecfe17e84ef36, which applied FHIR-14195 canonical :below guidance. No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-26558 was found for source/search.html, but b27671c2b1000f7d2e2028d9aaf5ff5b7be472c9 later replaced those examples with QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire examples.
additional_context: FHIR-38709 later reported the same search-page example family and suggested using _profile plus removing the duplicated http. Current source validates the replacement examples against an active QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire SearchParameter over a canonical element.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The reported malformed examples are absent from current source/search.html, and the replacement examples use valid canonical URLs and a current-build search parameter.
